Container.Name: seekquel-bridge
Container.Overview: Logs what you listen to on Audiobookshelf into Seekquel: listening time, your place and finished books. Start it, open the WebUI, sign in to Audiobookshelf and approve it in Seekquel. Nothing else to set.

Config.Name: Web page
Config.Description: The page where you sign in and see what is being logged.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Keeps the connection so you only set it up once.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf address
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty and type it on the page if it is not found by itself.
